decisions.reason: A rye country bread builds on existing recipes and production, so it costs little to keep while demand is still unclear.
The repeated gold medal from the Deutsches Brotinstitut shows the premium raisin stollen's value is already being realized, and as a seasonal product it is cheap to carry.
This seeded rye mixed bread is a low-cost extension of the core range with uncertainty not yet resolved, so keeping the option is worthwhile.
A dark malt rye bread uses existing processes and has no negative signal so far, so its option value still exceeds its small carrying cost.
Marzipan stollen is a staple seasonal product close to the established offer and complements the award-winning stollen line at little extra cost.
The newest ancient grain 'Meisterstück' targets a growing health trend, and its uncertain but promising prospects justify keeping it at low cost.
